name: Cloak of Chaos
summary: Ward allies against attacks, possession, and lawful magic.
description: Each warded creature gains +4 deflection AC, +4 resistance on saves, and spell resistance 25 against lawful spells and spells from lawful creatures. The ward blocks possession and mental influence as Protection from Law does. A lawful creature that lands a melee hit on a warded target is confused for one round unless it succeeds at a Will save against this spell.
target: one creature/level in a 20-ft.-radius burst centered on you
